video_title: Jaylen Brown trade rumors continue to swirl as NBA free agency approaches

quotes.speaker: Tom E. Curran
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade value is higher than it has ever been
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is a situation where you would be selling high. He's never had a better season.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is a situation where you would be selling high. He's never had a better season. And the analytics did over the course of time bear out that he was lower than generally the feeling was about him in the league. But right now, I think that his trade value is higher than it's ever been. It's great to have the best duo in the league, but if you don't have a front-line center and you don't have a point guard who can initiate offense and create on his own, then I understand why the Celtics would continue to try and get better in that avenue.

quotes.speaker: Adam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Jones is intrigued by a potential Alperen Sengun trade
quotes.excerpt: I'm intrigued by the Alperen Sengun deal only because of where the Celtics are at.
quotes.quote: I'm intrigued by the Alperen Sengun deal only because of where the Celtics are at. I did not want to trade Jaylen Brown in the first place. I did not want Giannis Antetokounmpo. Now I'm like, man, I wish they just threw Alperen Sengun into a deal and they just threw Trey Murphy or Evan Mobley into a deal, because now we're talking about scraps from the Blazers, or Trey Murphy, or Evan Mobley who I don't like. So now I got to make the best of what is out there. Alperen Sengun sounds pretty good. If Kawhi Leonard is really in play and he's being linked to other teams, but apparently the Clippers really like Jaylen Brown, Kawhi to me would be a pretty good return. If you're trying to make salaries match, and I've not heard this name out there, I'm intrigued by Devin Booker in Phoenix, but you're scrambling.

quotes.speaker: Kayla Burton
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' failed pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo led to current trade uncertainty
quotes.excerpt: If they had said, okay, we're going to go all in on Giannis, we're at least getting Giannis.

text_blocks.speaker: Kayla Burton
text_blocks.text: The only reason why they may have screwed up is because they know that they want to trade Jaylen Brown. If they had said, okay, we're going to go all in on Giannis, which includes Ugo Egbunu, Bailer Shairman, and a couple of picks, and Jaylen Brown, we're at least getting Giannis Antetokounmpo. I didn't love the deal, but at least they get their big man, right? That checks it off and answers the question. If we don't get Giannis, we're going to keep Jaylen Brown. But the problem is, that's not what they're looking like they're doing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tom E. Curran
text_blocks.text: How do you get they screwed it up? I don't know if they were both feet in. If they were both feet in, then they would have gone with Shairman and Gonzalez. I just don't think they were both feet in. They dabbled. They were dabbling. Can we get this for that? Oh, you want those two? Nah, we don't really want them that much.

quotes.speaker: Trenni Casey
quotes.summary_phrase: Trenni Casey believes Jaylen Brown is tired of trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Jaylen Brown wants to be here anymore.
quotes.quote: I don't think Jaylen Brown wants to be here anymore. And I don't think it's because he doesn't like the city or he doesn't like the team. I think he is tired of being dangled in trade rumors. I think he is tired of playing second fiddle to someone that he thinks he's better than. And when Brad Stevens gets out in front of everybody after the Giannis trade falls through and doesn't say, no, Jaylen's our guy, we want to keep him, that sends a message. I think Jaylen's finally like, you know what? I'm done here. You don't want me, I don't want you.

quotes.speaker: Trenni Casey
quotes.summary_phrase: The Ringer's trade proposal for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: The most intriguing and fair trade: Brown for Alperen Sengun, Tari Eason, a Simon trade, the Rockets' pick.
quotes.quote: The most intriguing and fair trade: Brown for Alperen Sengun, Tari Eason, a Simon trade, the Rockets' 2027 first-round pick swap, which will likely yield the Brooklyn Nets 2027 first-rounder, and a 2030 first-round pick. I like it because you get a big man in return, which is something that this team desperately needs. But I also like, if you're going to get the Brooklyn Nets 2027 first-rounder, that could be a lottery pick. That could be a high pick so you could add more talent for Jayson Tatum and Sengun, who could possibly grow and flourish in this system if he gets out of Houston.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst says a Jaylen Brown contract extension is unlikely
quotes.excerpt: I guess it's not impossible that Jaylen Brown and the Celtics could get back together.
quotes.quote: I guess it's not impossible that Jaylen Brown and the Celtics could get back together, but I think that's highly unlikely. They're offering him everywhere, Rich. I mean, I'm not in the Celtics' offices, so I can't say for sure, but I've heard the Celtics attached to—I'm not even going to put a number on it because then I'd have to defend that number—but many, many teams.
